thread:
dario: Quick heads-up — scheduling a hotfix deploy in the quiet window today at 18:00 UTC. Small schema tweak + app-level guard. Need smoke owners and rollback custodian.

alice: I can own smoke checks. Will run API and frontend sanity.

sam_dev: I'll be on deploy. ETA 17:45 for final bake of the artifact.

jen_ops: DB migration note — it's an idempotent column add (no backfill). We still need a feature flag roll forward plan if something breaks.

maya_sre: Can we keep canary at 2% for first 15m, then 20% for 10m, then full if green?

jen_ops: yep, that cadence looks good. Rollback point is previous tag `release-2026.03.10`.

alice: Smoke checklist (short):
1) health endpoint + auth check
2) embedding job quick-run (dev queue)
3) core inference latency check (<120ms p50)
4) trace count sanity in honeycomb

alice: I'll paste the smoke commands right before deploy.

sam_dev: Deploy plan:
- 17:40 freeze commits
- 17:45 build + push image
- 17:55 start canary (2%)
- 18:10 promote to 20%
- 18:20 full rollout if no blockers

maya_sre: Add runbook snippet for rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-server --to-revision=release-2026.03.10` and revert feature flag via LaunchDarkly AES toggle.

jen_ops: Confirming DB lock-free change so rollback doesn't require DB revert. Good.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @sam_dev at 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z — Canaries enabled: true — Canary config: [2%, 20%].

dario: tagging people — @alice for smoke, @maya_sre for monitoring, @jen_ops for DB watch. Please :thumbsup: to indicate you're available during the window.

alice: :thumbsup: I'll be online 17:30-19:00 UTC.

maya_sre: :thumbsup: monitoring + alerting watches set.

sam_dev: :thumbsup: build + deploy. Keeping my phone nearby.

jen_ops: :thumbsup: on DB side.

alice: smoke commands (run after 2% canary is up):
```bash
# basic health
curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example.org/health | jq .status
# quick gen
curl -fsS -X POST https://api.redwood.example.org/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck","max_tokens":8}' | jq .choices[0].text
# latency sample (10 requests)
for i in {1..10}; do time curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.example.org/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping","max_tokens":2}'; done
```

maya_sre: I'll watch error rate and tail logs for 5m after each promotion. If error rate >0.5% spike, we pause and decide.

dario: One more: keep an eye on unit-cost token spend during canary. If cost per 1k tokens jumps >25% relative baseline, pause.

sam_dev: acknowledged. Also I added a short QA eval set to compare responses vs previous model variant as a sanity check.

jen_ops: If rollback: we'll also revoke the new feature flag and roll back the image. I'll coordinate with sam for immediate rollout undo.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: 17:30 UTC — "pre-deploy checklist: locks, build verification, smoke owner ready".

alice: All good from my side. Will post results inline when I run smoke.

dario: Thanks team — executing as planned. Ping here if anything unexpected.

sam_dev: will post the image digest + canary IDs once pushed.

alice: smoke run results (18:02): health OK, quick gen OK, latency p50=98ms, no errors seen. :white_check_mark:

maya_sre: Observability: traces look normal, error rate flat. Continuing watch.

sam_dev: promoted to 20% at 18:10.

alice: smoke re-run (18:13): still green, embedding job queued and processed on dev queue.

maya_sre: no notable anomalies, proceeding to full rollout at 18:20 per plan.

sam_dev: full rollout started. image: sha256:abc123...

deploy-bot: rollout complete at 18:22 UTC.

dario: Excellent — thanks everyone. Closing window. I'll update the release notes with the rollback tag and smoke artifacts.

jen_ops: leaving post-deploy monitor until 19:00 then stand down.

sam_dev: thx all.
